interest_basis: Net cash tax: interest is charged on the tax paid in cash after input tax credit, not on the gross liability.
interest_note: Simple interest at 18% per annum on the net cash tax, pro rated by days delayed divided by 365. The 24% rate applies only when the notice states section 50(3). Estimator only; verify on the GST portal.
legacy_note: 12% and 28% were withdrawn for most supplies from 22 September 2025. Use them only to verify invoices dated before that date, and only when explicitly requested.

penalty_no_fraud.note: Rough estimator input only, carried from the previous app values; not a demand computation. Verify on the official portal.

notes: Current rates were checked against the secondary sources listed above on 2026-11-16. They agree: from 22 September 2025 the main GST rates are 5% (merit) and 18% (standard), with 40% for a short de-merit list and 0% for exempt supplies, under Notification 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) following the 56th GST Council decisions. The 12% and 28% rates were withdrawn for most supplies and are kept here as legacy rates for invoices dated before 22 September 2025 only. The notification text itself was not read directly, so verified stays false. The rate for a specific supply depends on its HSN or SAC code and conditions: verify on the CBIC GST rate finder or the GST portal before billing.
